article.articleTextExcerpt: A monorail runs on a single elevated beam rather than a conventional two-rail track. That makes it a compact, fully elevated mode, useful on dense urban corridors where road space is tight. In India the flagship is the Mumbai Monorail, the country’s first and so far only system. This page covers monorail in India: how the technology works, where it runs, and the latest developments. A monorail vehicle straddles or hangs from a single guideway beam, usually on rubber tyres. The result is a small footprint, a tight turning radius and a quiet ride. Most modern systems, Mumbai’s included, use the straddle-beam design, where the train sits astride a slim concrete beam. On capacity it sits below metro. It works well as a feeder or on medium-demand corridors, but it cannot match a metro’s throughput, which is why cities weigh it carefully against light metro and Metrolite. The incident took place at a showroom under the Bajaj Nagar police station area, with more than five persons suspected to be involved in the burglary, they said. According to police, CCTV footage from the showroom shows two masked men removing the displayed watches and stuffing them in bags inside the store, while three to four others are seen waiting outside. The entire burglary was carried out in about 36 minutes, they said, adding that the accused allegedly broke the showroom shutter using an iron rod and entered the premises. The Sistan sand boa (Eryx sistanensis) is a non-venomous, thick-bodied snake found in dry areas. It was earlier known to be from Iran and Pakistan. Researchers Vivek Sharma of Jabalpur and wildlife biologist Dharmendra Khandal of Ranthambhore-based Tiger Watch found three of these snakes during a survey in the Ramgarh-Shekhawati area of Sikar in 2025. Their study was published in the Journal of Threatened Taxa on May 26 this year. The first snake was found inside a gaushala on August 19, 2025. Another was found in the courtyard of a house at Sunda Ki Dhani on September 12 and the third near an under-construction house at Rukansar on September 21 last year. The researchers studied their body shape, colour and scales before identifying them as Sistan sand boas. "We knew that this snake was different, but we did not rush to publish a research paper. Centuries later, his legacy has become central to the assertion of a community whose political significance carries weight in Punjab’s electoral politics. With the state government earmarking Rs 100 crore to mark his 650th birth anniversary, a larger question has emerged over how his spiritual vision of equality is being interpreted within electoral politics. Harinder Singh, scholar and founder of SikhRI, USA, said the problem began with how Ravidass was understood. Delivering a lecture at Bhai Vir Singh Niwas Sthaan as part of the 650th birth anniversary celebrations organised by the Bhai Vir Singh Heritage Museum and Library, he said debates over whether to describe him as Bhagat, Sant or Guru Ravidass had overshadowed his vision of an egalitarian society. Singh said Ravidass’s message challenged caste hierarchy, inherited status, exclusion and political and religious domination. article.articleTextExcerpt: The State Board of Technical Education and Industrial Training has made six months of industrial training mandatory for diploma students enrolled in six engineering courses across 26 government and 61 private polytechnic colleges. The programme will cover final-semester students from January to June, with a minimum 90 per cent attendance required for assessment. The courses include Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Civil Engineering. The programme was approved at the 43rd meeting of the board’s Academic Committee in June and will apply to existing batches enrolled in the six courses. Senior board officials said longer industry exposure was necessary as most diploma students join polytechnic courses after Class 10 and require greater practical understanding of industrial work, technical tools, safety practices and workplace environment. Officials said the six courses were initially selected because they have the highest enrolment and are offered widely across polytechnic colleges.
